import 'dart:async';

/// What the last call of [later] answered, when it has.
int seen = 0;

/// Answers after a while. Nobody has to wait for it.
Future<int> later(int value) async {
  await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 30));
  final answer = value * 2;
  seen = answer;
  return answer;
}

/// Ticks until it is told to stop, which nobody may do.
Timer every(Duration interval, void Function() tick) =>
    Timer.periodic(interval, (_) => tick());

int ticksIn(int milliseconds, int interval) =>
    interval <= 0 ? 0 : milliseconds ~/ interval;
